name: Colorado
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

blurb.text: A state whose vineyards lie mostly on the western slope of the Rocky Mountains, with more wineries along the Front Range. Its most planted grapes are Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Riesling and Chardonnay. Its AVAs are Grand Valley and West Elks.
